logger.doc:name: Log GET Orders Request
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "Fetching orders from orders staging table.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

db:select.doc:name: Fetch Orders From Database
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, orderId, customerName, customerEmail, productName, quantity, orderAmount, currency, orderStatus, sourceSystem, orderCreatedAt, orderCancelledAt, ingestionStatus, syncStatus, syncMessage, salesforceId, fileName, createdAt, updatedAt FROM ordersStaging

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: false, message: "No orders found.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }

logger.doc:name: Log No Orders Found
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "No orders found.", correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { success: true, message: "Orders fetched successfully.", totalRecords: sizeOf(payload), correlationId: vars.correlationId, data: payload }

logger.doc:name: Log GET Orders Response
logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { appName: app.name, flowName: flow.name, message: "Orders fetched successfully.", totalRecords: payload.totalRecords, correlationId: vars.correlationId, timestamp: now() }]
